plugins.name: humanizer-voice
plugins.description: Learned voice profile + quiet delivery gate; user surface is /voice. Learn once, scan in background, patch-in-place repairs.

plugins.name: voice-gate
plugins.description: Deterministic pre-delivery tell gate: 55-pattern regex scan (plus optional embedder cosine), fail-open, span-level repair contracts. Reference implementation behind the /voice gate.

plugins.name: decision-advisor
plugins.description: Meta-cognitive decision analysis for one-way doors: expand options, contract to the elegant solution, embed enforcement. Use when the user says: 'decide whether to...', 'run a meta-decision on...', 'stress-test this decision'.

plugins.name: uxr-plugin
plugins.description: UX research operations: studies, specs, recruitment, interview scripts, reports, decks. Use when the user says: 'start a new study', 'write an interview script', 'show my tickets', 'recruiting status', 'end of day update'.
